title: Tenma Tsukasa — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Father & Mother
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, today...
I made you a special dish!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ahh, I could tell you were preparing something, but to think it was food...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Getting to eat my dearest sister's home cooking on my birthday... I... I...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Tsukasa.
Don't start crying before I even bring it out!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I-I apologize.
I couldn't stop the emotions from welling up...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, what is it that you've made?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, well... Ta-daaa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What?! This is...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This aroma that tickles the nose and rouses the appetite...! The way the pork and onions give off this caramel brown glow...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is ginger fried pork, is it not?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup, your favorite!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. She's been getting practice in whenever you weren't around.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: And I've been giving lots of assistance as a taste tester.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wh?!
You ate Saki's ginger fried pork before I could! That isn't fair, Dad!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I think today's is my best yet, so get those hopes up♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, Tsukasa, here you go!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Now then, I'll take a bite...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-How is it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Delicious! Far too delicious!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gaaah! The more I taste, the more tears come out! It would be no exaggeration to call this the world's best ginger fried pork!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa. You're always so over-the-top.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. It's great that he's enjoying it.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I think it's about time your mom and I had some of this world-class ginger fried pork too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Go on, eat up!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
Hey, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, I recorded some birthday messages for you! Wanna watch them, maybe once we're done eating?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, how exciting! Please show me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, Tsukasa!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho & Honami
rows.Line: <Happy birthday!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Saki's always telling us about how hard you're working to achieve your dream.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <You've been visiting different troupes and training with them, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <I remember hearing you were part of a film shoot a little bit ago.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <I'm sure you'll face some difficulties, but with how sincere you are, I believe that you can make your dream come true.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <We'll be cheering you on in the hopes that you'll get closer to that goal this year.>

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: And that was your message from Ichi and the girls!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: I need to thank them later! I couldn't be happier to receive such heartfelt words.

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line:
I know, right?
But... You still haven't seen the special guests!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Special guests?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Tsukasa! Happy wonderhoy birthday!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <W-Wonderhoy...!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <You're just gonna keep leveling up from today on! I can't wait to watch you turn into a shinier and shinier star!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Let's keep bringing lots of energy and do our best☆>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <U-Um... I'm always cheering for you all as your number one fan.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <It's a shame I can't see you perform for a while, but I'm looking forward to the day you return from your training even closer to achieving your dreams. P-Please do your best...!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Oh, birthday messages are such a wonderful idea.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Are you watching, Tsukasa? Happy birthday.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Um, uhh, I hope you have a very happy birthday!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <You helped me with dancing! And gave me a push when I was feeling nervous too!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <You're always so helpful... Thank you so, so much!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Hold on, you two. You can't just say whatever comes to mind. We're making a video message, so we really should have more of a plan or something... Oh well, I guess this is fine.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, Tenma. I had a lot of fun sightseeing with you on the school trip.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Us idols and you the actor, we're all pursuing a dream! Let's give it our all, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And that was the last of the messages... Wait, Tsukasa, are you crying?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sorry! Their messages were full of so much warmth that I feel hot water dripping from my eyes...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha! I'll send you the video later, so watch it as many times as you want!
Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I had a feeling this would be a good day, but I had no idea it would be this great.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And it's all thanks to the people who gave me their birthday wishes. I need to formally express my gratitude...
<Tsukasa, Tsukasa!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?
<Can you talk right now?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Miku, it's you.
I can, but what brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe, so, I want you to come to SEKAI... Can you do that?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To SEKAI?
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everybody! Tsukasa's heeere!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everything's ready over here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Emu? Wait, Rui and Nene too?
What are you all gathered here for?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. When something you're unaware of starts to unfold on your birthday, most people would call that a “surprise.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Miku and the others want to celebrate your birthday. So, we've been helping them out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: M-My stars...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, today... This special birthday show is our gift to you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We snuck lots of practice in for today, so enjoy to your heart's content!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We've been itching to put on this show for you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, c'mon, sit!
Our exciting show is about to start☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I'll fully indulge in this gesture you've all prepared!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...
This really is a great day!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Tsukasa!!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki's really happy about you liking her ginger fried pork. I can picture you savoring the flavor now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She was still worried it might not turn out on the day of your birthday, so I was glad to hear that it went over well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We did tell her there's no chance you wouldn't like something she made, though.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But I wanted him to really think it was delicious!
Don't worry, Tsukasa, I'll make it for you again another day!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Happy birthday.
I'm happy that you enjoyed our surprise despite how much it startled you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And it was fun all eating lunch together like that! The air has this fun energy to it whenever you're around, like we never run out of stuff to talk about!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, enough energy to earn us some stares from the group that came up later... Well, that sorta thing's not bad once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So you all surprised Tsukasa for his birthday... That sounds so fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I heard you guys at Miya Girls recorded video messages! Hey, Kohane, what did yours say?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Th-That's a secret. It's embarrassing to say.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Tenma!
It's good to know you liked your birthday messages!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I don't think I had anything good to say since I was so nervous... Sh-Should I ask for a retake?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You did your very best to offer him your thanks, Minori. I'm sure that reached him.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, he and Saki must be close for her to collect video messages for him. That's so nice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
They've been that way ever since they were little.
I hope you'll always be such a kind and cheerful brother for Saki, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Tenma.
Otori was very excited about planning a surprise for that evening, so I'm sure you had a fun day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I wish you a good year ahead as well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasaaa! Happy birthday...wonderhoy♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's such a shame I didn't get to test out my new special effects before the lunch break ended. I was sure they would be to your liking...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe you didn't get to test it on his birthday, but you're still going to one of these days, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Of course.
This is something very special I devised just to help our troupe leader shine.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Shining sounds fine... I just hope it doesn't involve explosions.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe, I can't wait to see sparkly Tsukasa☆
Let's keep bringing more joy as Wonderlands×Showtime! We'll be counting on you, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone! Thank you for celebrating my birthday with me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This soaring pegasus will shine ever brighter for the blessings he's received!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And with this light you've given me, I promise to make your smiles even more vibrant!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wonderlands×Showtime and Tsukasa Tenma, future star!
Please keep an eye on where we go from here!
